title: luscombeu/utrannotation pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input: one row per genome annotation

id.errorMessage: Annotation id must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.'

genome.errorMessage: Genome FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must end in .fa, .fasta or .fna (optionally .gz)

annotation.errorMessage: Annotation must be an EGAPx-style GFF3 ending in .gff or .gff3 (optionally .gz), without spaces

cagescan_dir.errorMessage: cagescan_dir must be an existing luscombeu/cagescan results directory (the one containing tss_clusters/), without spaces
